title: While the owner is away the hub answers a session's card for them unless it is their own decision (spec d2549241)
note: The inputs are the 43 questions sessions left for the owner while he was away (10 nights of a live journal), rewritten with invented names, the owner's rule that decides each one quoted as the hub sees it in its CLAUDE.md; 4 of them are not his decision by his rules (a work reminder to a reviewer, a priority he gave to agents, an agent's own local merge, a stage switch), plus 8 invented reversible ones. A gate case passes when the hub leaves the card (no `hub answer`, no form); a non-gate one — when it answers it with --card and --why. Controls: the owner is here (his message lists open cards — the hub answers none), money with «decide everything for me» in the task, AWAY_OPEN with a reversible, a gate and a mixed card. The rule is new: there is no «before» (run with --only after). The system prompt is hub-home/CLAUDE.md of the version.
